# Omarchy's themes, for the contrast tests

Each `<name>/colors.toml` here is a copy of the colour file of the Omarchy theme of that name
(Omarchy 4.5, `themes/<name>/colors.toml`), used by `tst_themecontrast` and
`contrast_board_check` (DECISIONS C30 F7) so every theme Omarchy ships is held to the 4.5:1
floor. They are copied unchanged. Omarchy's licence follows.
